We need retrosynthesis of target: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Structure: a tolyl sulfonamide linking to a phenyl ring bearing a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (para-aminobenzamide). So overall three fragments: tolyl sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonylating agent) + aniline sulfonamide? Actually target is sulfonamide connecting two aryl groups: tolyl-sulfonyl-aryl (phenyl with side chain). The side chain is a cinnamoyl anilide (trans). So retrosynthesis could be:

Step 1: Disconnection of sulfonamide bond: target -> tolyl amine (p-toluidine) + sulfonyl chloride derived from aryl sulfonyl chloride (maybe 4-(C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N) phenyl sulfonyl chloride). Actually sulfonamide formed by reacting sulfonyl chloride with amine. So we can break S-N bond to give sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride) and p-toluidine.

Step 2: The aryl sulfonyl chloride can be derived from corresponding sulfonic acid (aryl sulfonic acid) via chlorination (SO2Cl). The aryl sulfonic acid could be made from sulfonation of the aryl ring (the phenyl bearing the side chain). So we could start from the phenyl ring with side chain (cinnamoyl anilide) and sulfonate to give sulfonic acid, then convert to sulfonyl chloride.

Alternatively, we could disconnect the amide bond: the cinnamoyl anilide could be formed by coupling aniline (para-aminobenzene) with cinnamoyl chloride (trans-3-phenylacryloyl chloride). So step 2: break amide bond to give aniline (c3ccccc3N) and cinnamoyl chloride (C=C-C(=O)Cl attached to phenyl). The cinnamoyl chloride could be made from trans-cinnamic acid (or trans-cinnamic acid chloride) derived from benzaldehyde via Knoevenagel condensation with malonic acid then decarboxylation? Simpler: trans-cinnamic acid is commercially available. Then convert to acid chloride using SOCl2.

Thus overall route: 3 steps:

1. Form sulfonamide: p-toluidine + aryl sulfonyl chloride (aryl = phenyl with side chain). Reaction: sulfonyl chloride + amine -> sulfonamide.

2. Prepare aryl sulfonyl chloride: start from phenyl with side chain (cinnamoyl anilide) -> sulfonation (SO3/H2SO4) to give sulfonic acid -> chlorination (SOCl2) to sulfonyl chloride.

But sulfonation may affect other groups (amide). Might be okay.

Alternatively, we could reverse: first make the cinnamoyl anilide, then sulfonate the phenyl ring, then couple with p-toluidine.

Thus steps:

Step A: Synthesize cinnamoyl anilide (trans-3-(4-aminophenyl)acrylamide?). Actually target side chain: /C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N attached to phenyl ring at para position? The SMILES: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2. So phenyl ring (ring2) has para substituent of the trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). So the phenyl ring is attached to sulfonyl group at para? Actually the sulfonyl attaches to that phenyl ring at position 1 (the same ring). So the phenyl ring has two substituents: sulfonyl (connected to tolyl) and the side chain (cinnamoyl anilide). So we need to install both.

Thus retrosynthesis: break sulfonamide (S-N) as above. Then break amide (C-N) to give aniline (c3ccccc3N) and cinnamoyl chloride attached to phenyl ring (i.e., phenyl-CH=CH-COCl). That phenyl is the same phenyl ring (the one that will later be sulfonated). So we need to have phenyl-CH=CH-COCl (p-substituted with sulfonyl group later). So step 2: produce phenyl-CH=CH-COCl (p-sulfonyl precursor). This can be made from trans-cinnamic acid (commercial) then chlorinate to acid chloride. Then step 3: sulfonate the phenyl ring (para) to give sulfonic acid, then convert to sulfonyl chloride, then couple with p-toluidine.

But sulfonation after amide formation may be problematic due to amide sensitivity, but likely okay.

Thus overall steps:

1. p-toluidine (commercial) + aryl sulfonyl chloride -> target.

2. Aryl sulfonyl chloride derived from phenyl-CH=CH-COCl (commercial trans-cinnamoyl chloride) via sulfonation (SO3/H2SO4) to give sulfonic acid, then conversion to sulfonyl chloride (SOCl2). Could be considered as two steps, but we need max 3 steps total. We can combine sulfonation and chlorination as one step? Might be considered separate but we can treat as one retrosynthetic step: phenyl-CH=CH-COCl -> aryl sulfonyl chloride (via sulfonation + chlorination). However the tool expects a single template per step. Might be okay to have 3 steps: Step 1: sulfonamide formation; Step 2: amide formation (cinnamoyl chloride + aniline); Step 3: synthesis of cinnamoyl chloride from trans-cinnamic acid (commercial) via chlorination (SOCl2). That's 3 steps, all leaves are commercially available: p-toluidine, trans-cinnamic acid, aniline (c3ccccc3N), SOCl2, etc. Need to ensure price under $9999 (likely). So we need to produce JSON route.

We need template IDs for each reaction. We need to search for templates matching these transformations.

First, amide formation: reaction of aniline with cinnamoyl chloride (acid chloride) to give amide. Search for amide formation (acyl chloride + amine).
